text: This solution, Natural Hazards Commission Toka Tū Ake: Risk Reduction Framework and Tools (2024–2025) addresses natural catastrophe through public private partnerships in New Zealand between Natural Hazards Commission Toka Tū Ake, Central and Local Government, NEMA, Regional Councils, World Forum of Catastrophe Programmes, World Bank, BRANZ, MBIE, NZ Geotechnical Society, NZSEE, SESOC, GNS Science, NIWA, and University of Auckland. The program was implemented in 2024 and focuses on collaboration, raising awareness, and regulation.
